thread:
tom: Deploybot flagged an automated safety latch on canary for v3.4.1 at 09:13 UTC. p95 jump and some 5xxs. anyone seeing this on dashboards? :thinking:

deploybot: automated-checks: canary p95 220ms -> 760ms (+245%). 5xx rate 0.05% -> 0.9%. traffic slice: canary-5%. action: safety-latch triggered (auto-pause). suggest: rollback to last stable or increase slice to 20% for more signal.

anya: auto-pause is good. we shouldn't widen traffic now. what's the rollback surface?

sre-bot: correlation: new kernel tuning + new attention kernel shipped in this build. traces show OOM-ish GC spikes on some pods.

ops-lead: quick options: 1) let safety-latch hold and keep canary at 0% while we debug, 2) manual rollback/pin to 3.4.0 which is quick, 3) hotpatch turning off the attentions kernel flag but that risks partial behavior mismatch. My vote: pin and notify customers.

release-eng: if we pin, I will add a short "rolled back due to perf regression" note and version pin to release page.

legal: FYI if customer SLA impacted, flag to Legal. but from initial numbers looks small. keep me updated.

pm: We need to stop the release window until we decide. no more merges.

tom: ops, can you run the rollback-runbook? prefer manual pin so we have a clean signal.

ops-lead: triggering rollback-runbook now. run-id rb-1767729999-a. steps: freeze -> drain canaries -> deploy previous image -> smoke checks -> reopen traffic. ETA 6m.

deploybot: rollback-runbook started by ops-lead at 09:16:12 UTC. draining pods: canary-2/3.

anya: i'll stand by to patch release notes and draft customer messaging.

sre-bot: note: keep kernel tuning experiment enabled for debug until we reproduce locally. assign to @anya for capture.

ops-lead: rolling previous image redwood/inference:3.4.0 -> applying to canary set.

deploybot: image update complete. waiting for readiness.

release-eng: publishing interim RN: "v3.4.1 paused; reverted to v3.4.0 due to performance regression on canary. Investigating, will follow up." posting to #release-notes for CSM review.

deploybot: smoke checks passed. p95 back to 230ms, 5xx 0.06%. run-id rb-1767729999-a completed at 09:22:59 UTC.

pm: please keep the window blocked until postmortem. create incident and invite infra.

ops-lead: created INC-17677. hard-stop active. no merges until postmortem. tagging SRE and release-eng.

legal: thanks, keep me in loop if any customer outreach goes beyond the blurb.

anya: customer blurb ready and queued to send once release-eng greenlights. also saved logs to internal S3 for debug.

tom: good run. postmortem owners? assign to @sre-bot and @ops-lead with release-eng in support. I'll file the follow-up ticket.

sre-bot: assigned. starting root-cause triage on kernel tuning + attention kernel. will report in 2h.
